(* REQ: LANG-1231 LANG-1232 LANG-1233 LANG-1234 *)
Require Import Arith.

(* outer (* nested *) still a comment *)
Inductive shape : Type :=
  | Circle : nat -> shape
  | Rect : nat -> nat -> shape.

Definition area (s : shape) : nat :=
  match s with
  | Circle r => 3 * r * r
  | Rect w h => w * h
  end.

Fixpoint double (n : nat) : nat :=
  match n with
  | O => O
  | S n' => S (S (double n'))
  end.

Theorem double_plus : forall n, double n = n + n.
Proof.
  intros n. induction n as [| n' IH].
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. lia.
Qed.

Definition greeting := "Hello, ""Coq""!".
Compute double 21.
